title: Provenance screening for routine health-programme data: an instrument and two applications to WHO tuberculosis datasets
description:
Reproducible screens that distinguish, from the published file alone, which variables in a country-reported health dataset carry annual measurements and which carry carried-forward estimates or categorical status flags.

Applied to 443 numeric variables across six WHO Global Tuberculosis Programme datasets (budget; expenditure and utilisation; notifications; treatment outcomes; laboratory diagnostic services; contact tracing and preventive treatment), and to India's national TB financing accounts from the India TB Report 2024.

Contains: the screening instrument and its five tests; a propagation and expected-value-of-audit module; the archived WHO input files as downloaded; a 255-test verification suite; and FINDINGS.md, a durable record of every verified result and every correction made during development, including four self-corrections found by replication.
